corpus.provenance: Locally authored, deterministic, self-contained synthetic workload; not an accuracy benchmark.
corpus.length_policy: 1 / 4 / 16 document paragraphs for short / medium / long; actual tokenizer lengths saved per model.
corpus.split_policy: Prompt-level 200/100, stratified by task and length; disjoint scenario IDs, names and numerical instances.
corpus.test_use: Never used for expert swaps, g selection, stacking selection or search-budget tuning.

collection.routing: Actual llama.cpp ffn_moe_topk callback, independent sequence IDs, CPU, greedy, fixed EOS-inclusive length.
collection.checkpoint_policy: Resume whole original sequence batches to preserve numerical configuration.
